name: HIST 5610
title: Comparative Transnational Latin(o) American History
description: (Also offered as LLAS 5100.) Critical issues in diverse U.S. Latina/o histories and forces that contributed to the arrival of people of Latin American and Caribbean heritage to the United States. Topics include: the epistemological origins and historiographical traditions of the field; U.S. empire; labor, migration, and diaspora; border formations; constructions of gender and sexuality; and comparative racialization.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
